frozenHandling.intro: Every order ships flash-frozen at −18°C in insulated packaging with gel ice packs to keep it that way in transit.
frozenHandling.tip1: Keep frozen until ready to use — don't refreeze after thawing.
frozenHandling.tip2: Thaw in the refrigerator for 12–24 hours depending on thickness, never at room temperature.
frozenHandling.tip3: For a faster thaw, submerge the sealed package in cold water, changing it every 30 minutes.
frozenHandling.tip4: Once thawed, cook within 2–3 days for the best quality and food safety.
